notes: Baseline: the same prompt with no skill. The main question is whether the directions are truly different and not generic.

evals.prompt: /explore Give me design directions for a reading-progress page for a book club app.
evals.expected_output: 6 to 8 written concepts as quick clickable pages, a shortlist request, then finished directions with a critique and a comparison page.
expectations: Real references are gathered with screenshots or links, or the reply says web access was unavailable
Concepts include an expected, a bold and a borrowed-from-another-category option
Every pair of concepts differs on at least two of: layout, density, type, color strategy, interaction
Each concept page passes check-page.mjs with no FAIL
No two concepts share the same layout skeleton with only colors swapped
A fresh critique pass scored the shortlist before the comparison page was made

evals.prompt: /explore Directions for our pricing page. Keep our brand.
evals.expected_output: Directions that all keep DESIGN.md colors and fonts and vary layout, density and interaction.
expectations: All directions use only DESIGN.md brand colors and fonts
Directions vary layout or interaction, not only color
check-page.mjs exits 0 on every direction page
The final question is one line: which direction, or which mix
